content: Obhwiikirirya bhuhiziri ebhibhi bhye ekyaaro
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akwiikirirya kubha Yeesu ni Krisito, wuyo niwe omwaana wa Taatabhugya. Wowoosi wuno akumuseega taata, arabhaseega naabhe abhaana bha taata wuyo.
Tumenyiri kubha, turabhaseega abhaana bha Taatabhugya kwe enzira yo okumuseega Taatabhugya, no okugwaata obhuswaagyo bhwaaye.
Okumuseega Taatabhugya nikwe okugwaata obhuswaagyo bhwaaye. Kweeki, okugwaata obhuswaagyo bhwaaye kutari kukongʼu,
kwo okubha abhaana bhoosi bha Taatabhugya bharahiza obhubhi bhwe ekyaaro. Kuno nikwo okuhiza ekyaaro kwo obhwiikirirya bhweetu.
Awee, ni weewi wuno akunagya okuhiza obhubhi bhwe ekyaaro? Ni wuno akwiikirirya kubha Yeesu ni Mwaana wa Taatabhugya.
Obhumenyeekererya iguru wa Yeesu Krisito

Yeesu Krisito niwe akakuundukurirwa kubha omwaana wa Taatabhugya kwa amaanzi go obhubatiizo bhwaaye na amanyiinga gaaye gano gakiitika kumusaraba. Ateerekirye ego kwo okubatiizwa kwa amaanzi ageene, nawe kwo okwiitira amanyiinga gaaye kumusaraba.
Kweeki neewe Ekoro Muhoreeru niwe wuno akumenyeekererya kubha ni ge eheene, kwo okubha Ekoro Muhoreeru niwe obhuheene.
Mbe, bhariho abhamenyeekererya bhatatu, bhano bhakweerekya amangʼana ga Yeesu [mwiisaaro, ni Taata, Engʼana ne Ekoro Muhoreeru, na abhatatu bhano ni bhamwe.

Kweeki, bhiriho bhitatu bhino bhikumenyeekererya mukyaaro], nabhyo ni Koro, amaanzi na amanyiinga, ne ebhitatu bhiyo bhiriikirirania. Eraabhe turiikirirya obhumenyeekererya bhwa abhaatu, eheene turanagya okwiikirirya obhumenyeekererya obhukuru bhuno Taatabhugya akaruusya iguru yo Omwaana waaye.

Wowoosi wuno akumwiikirirya Omwaana wa Taatabhugya, yiikirirye kubha obhumenyeekererya bhuyo ni bhwe eheene. Nawe wuno atakwiikirirya amangʼana ga Taatabhugya, arabhuga Taatabhugya ni mubheehi, kwo okubha akyaari kubhwiikirirya obhumenyeekererya bhuno Taatabhugya aruusirye iguru yo Omwaana waaye.
Obhumenyeekererya bhuyo nibhwo bhuno, Taatabhugya atuheeri obhuhoru bhwa kirakeego. Obhuhoru bhuyo, tubhweeni kwe enzira yo okwiikirirya Omwaana waaye.
Wowoosi wuno akubha no obhumwe no Omwaana wa Taatabhugya, anabhwo obhuhoru. Nawe wuno atana obhumwe no Omwaana wa Taatabhugya, atana obhuhoru.
Orubhaango rwo obhwiikari bhwa kirakeego
Nibhakaamiiri amangʼana gayo, bhano mukwiikirirya eriina ryo Omwaana wa Taatabhugya, okubha mumenye kubha muno obhuhoru bhwa kirakeego.
Etwe tuno obhukaari bhukuru embere wa Taatabhugya, kwo okubha tumenyiri aratwiigwa hano tukumusabha ryoryoosi kutuukana no obhuseegi bhwaaye.
Tumenyiri kubha aratwiitegeerera hano tukumusabha, nikyo tuno obhuheene bhwo okutuhaana bhino tukumusabha.

Kya wowoosi wuno akumurora omurikyaaye arakora ebhibhi bhino bhitakumwaahura omuutu kure na Taatabhugya kirakeego, amusabhire ku Taatabhugya, na Taatabhugya aramuha obhuhoru. Erabha ego kubhano bhakukora ebhibhi bhiyo. Nawe bhiriho ebhibhi bhino bhikumwaahura omuutu kure na Taatabhugya kirakeego. Enye nitakugaamba amusabhire ku Taatabhugya kubhibhi bhiyo.
Okukora ryoryoosi rino ritakungʼarira embere wa Taatabhugya, nikwo okukora ebhibhi. Nawe, hamwe na gayo, bhiriho ebhibhi bhino bhitakumwaahura omuutu kure na Taatabhugya kirakeego.
Tumenyiri kubha abhaana bha Taatabhugya bhatakugeenderera kukora ebhibhi,
kwo okubha Omwaana wa Taatabhugya arabhariiha, okubha Seetaani, omubhi wurya atamwe okubhakora ryoryoosi.
Tumenyiri kubha etwe ni bhaana bha Taatabhugya, ne ekyaaro kyoosi kirabhaahwa no omubhi wurya, Seetaani, omubhi wurya.

Kweeki tumenyiri kubha, Omwaana wa Taatabhugya amariri kuuza, na atuheeri amangʼeeni, okubha tumumenye Taatabhugya. Bhoono, tuno obhumwe na Taatabhugya we eheene, kwo okubha tuno obhumwe no Omwaana waaye Yeesu Krisito. Wuno niwe Taatabhugya we eheene no obhuhoru bhwa kirakeego.
Abhaana bhaane abhaseegwa mubhwiikirirya, mwiiriihe mutaaza kuseengera emisaambwa.

footnotes.text: Mutaaza kuseengera emisaambwa, obhugazuro obhuundi bhuratura kubha, mwiiriihe kure ne ebhigiro bhyoosi bhino bhikugega omweeya gwa Taatabhugya mukoro yaazo.
